items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...it seems like some other tune that Joe Merez used later then too. A pop tune that he played that on. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, that was the only English recording that I heard.

ctx.x: Well, I really don't remember, but Larry got a beautiful tone in the low register. Yeah. Now at that time, the equipment for recording, of course, you know what it was then. So his low register, I thought even though he played in the horn and the recording, you know, wasn't just, but his tone was really beautiful, I thought. Yeah. I'm forever blowing bubbles, you, you thinking of, huh?

I don't remember that, that's the title, it seems like another title to me too. I'm forever blowing bubbles. I don't have the record here now, it seems like some other tune that Joe Merez used later then too. A pop tune that he played that on.
Well, that was the only English recording that I heard. Did you use that low? That he played in the low register.
